messages.subject: Project Indigo — cap table and funds flow for completion
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus — attached are the pre/post-money cap table and the completion funds-flow statement. Post-money Brindley is ~19.4% fully diluted; Aldridge's £500k convertible note converts into Series B at completion and is reflected on the post tab. Funds flow nets to zero. Please confirm the Brindley and Aldridge payment references.

Elena
